summary.zh-Hant: 保加利亞公國的地位：依 1878 年柏林條約是鄂圖曼蘇丹宗主權下的自治納貢公國，實際上自行治理；1908-10-05 宣布獨立後這層關係才結束。這不是兩國爭奪同一塊地，而是名義上的宗主權與實際自治並存；本系統兩者都記，不裁判哪一個才算主權。
summary.en: Status of the Principality of Bulgaria: under the Treaty of Berlin (1878) an autonomous tributary principality under the suzerainty of the Sultan, self-governing in practice, until it proclaimed independence on 5 October 1908. Nominal suzerainty and actual autonomy stood side by side; both are recorded.

position.zh-Hant: 實際治理保加利亞與東魯米利亞。出處：柏林條約第 1 條、1886 年協議（Hertslet 第 4 卷，A）；保加利亞外交部長 1908-10-05 照會（FRUS 1908 Doc. 45，A）。
position.en: Governed Bulgaria and Eastern Roumelia in practice. Sources: Treaty of Berlin Art. I and the Arrangement of 1886 (Hertslet vol. IV, grade A); note of the Bulgarian foreign minister, 5 October 1908 (FRUS 1908, Doc. 45, grade A).

position.zh-Hant: 依柏林條約第 1 條對保加利亞公國有宗主權（Hertslet 第 4 卷，A）。資料庫裡鄂圖曼帝國的紀錄不含保加利亞，這項宗主權沒有另外畫範圍。
position.en: Held suzerainty over the Principality under Art. I of the Treaty of Berlin (Hertslet vol. IV, grade A). The Ottoman record does not include Bulgaria; no separate extent is drawn for the suzerainty.
